Short, fuzzy charcoal-black hair styled in a rounded bob. Large, blinking violet eyes with a playful expression. Appears to be in early adolescence. A petite, plump build with a round torso. Wears a black and yellow striped bodice with a small white collar. Features two thin antennae, two translucent insect wings, and a short, pointed black stinger tail.
BODY COLOR: yellow and black
